name: Work Relations and Assignments
constraints: Person identity remains external and survives employer changes.
Employment, contractor and agency engagement remain WM-ORG-005 records.
Assignments remain WM-ORG-016 records and resolve to one engagement context.
Employer, work customer and staffing supplier are explicit independent roles.
Effective amendments do not rewrite employment or assignment history.
Joiner, mover and leaver cases coordinate work but do not own source lifecycles.
Workflow closure does not prove entitlement revocation.
